topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: Hey, so you and your sister got Grandma’s house, huh? That’s big. I mean, it’s like, a whole house, and it’s just the two of you. What are you thinking? I know how much that place means to both of you. It’s like a chapter in your life that you’re suddenly responsible for. I bet there’s a million things to figure out, from the will to the furniture. You guys okay with it all? I hope you’re taking time to just... feel it, you know? And to remember all the good times. I’m here, okay? Just hit me up whenever you need to talk it out.
